messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-pool-usw2: spot-preemptions causing rapid pool shrink — queue growth > 500 pending requests, throttling engaged. Trigger: pool util > 95% + preempt events spike. Page on-call.
Alex (SRE): got page, jumping in. Observed 5xx spike from inference router and token latency up ~3x. Root thread_ts for this thread is 1781122334.
Maria (infra): confirming — K8s node events show repeated PreemptibleTermination notices on g4dn-type nodes starting 1781122200. Autoscaler did new node requests but API quotas returning 429 for spot requests.
Devon (autoscale): autoscaler logs: "scale_up_attempts=8, pending_provision=120m, provider_rate_limited=true". The fallback to on-demand pool didn't kick — checking policy binding now.
Riley (prod): customer impact: a handful of high-throughput tenants are experiencing timeouts on text-gen routes; we've got error budget burn on two paid customers. No major data loss but degraded service. Alerts: slo-bot flagged p99 latency breach for route /v1/generate.
Alex (SRE): initial mitigation plan: 1) Pause noncritical low-priority queues. 2) Force new pods onto on-demand nodegroup. 3) Temporary throttle back burstable customers to preserve reserved capacity. Who can flip the nodegroup? Priya?
Priya (ops lead): I can flip, but need the exact command and confirmation on which nodepool. We have two candidate nodegroups: "usw2-spot" and "usw2-on-demand-reserve". If we start on-demand, cost will spike.
Devon (autoscale): command to increase on-demand min size:

```
# GKE example
gcloud container clusters resize redwood-usw2 --node-pool=usw2-on-demand-reserve --num-nodes=6
```

We should also patch the autoscaler policy to allow immediate fallback. Current policy has cooldown 10m and requires spot failure ratio 0.3 — that's not firing fast enough.
Maria (infra): I'm seeing quota errors from the cloud provider when trying to request additional spot nodes; on-demand quota still free. I'll run the resize now.
Maria (infra): running resize... output: "Resizing node pool... operation started: op-0a1b2c". ETA ~2m.
SLO Bot: SLO: /v1/generate p99 latency breached 2.6x for 12m, SLA risk threshold approaching. Customers impacted: cust-acute, cust-labs.
Riley (prod): notify cust-acute support channel, set expectation: degraded for next ~15-30m, optional failover to cached responses where available. I'll draft a short note.
Alex (SRE): while on-demand comes up, we need immediate token-level mitigation: reduce max-concurrency on inference router from 32 -> 12 for untrusted API keys. This will shed load.
Devon (autoscale): I can patch router config. Command:

```
kubectl -n infra patch deploy inference-router -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"router","env":[{"name":"MAX_CONCURRENCY","value":"12"}]}]}}}}'
```

Applying now.
Maria (infra): on-demand nodes are bootstrapping. New nodes registering to cluster at 1781122450.
Alex (SRE): checking queue backlog metric: pending_requests fell from 520 -> 210 after throttle and new nodes. CPU on backends still high because KV cache warmup is ongoing.
Devon (autoscale): autoscaler policy updated: lower cooldown to 1m and allow fallback=true. Pushing patch to infra repo.
Priya (ops lead): I want an explicit manual reservation for critical tenants: we should allocate at least 4 GPUs reserved as on-demand for high-SLA customers. Can we set taints/tolerations so only high-tier pods schedule there?
Maria (infra): yes; creating a tainted nodepool "usw2-critical-od" and will add node-affinity for critical deployments. That will take ~7m.
SLO Bot: Note: create incident ticket INC-2026-178112 to track customer updates and RCA.
Riley (prod): posted customer note to cust-acute: "We're investigating a regional capacity disruption in us-west2 affecting inference latency; mitigation underway; will update in 20m." :thumbsup:
Alex (SRE): followup: discovered an autoscaler regression from last week's rollout — spot fallback flag was accidentally gated behind a feature flag "enable-fallback-2026" which didn't roll forward. Adding a hotfix to remove the gate.
Devon (autoscale): hotfix merged and deployed at 1781122580. Autoscaler started to request additional on-demand capacity as fallback. Monitoring metrics.
Maria (infra): critical nodepool up: 4 on-demand GPUs ready, taints applied. Migrating critical pods with pod disruption budgets respected.
Alex (SRE): queue now shrunk to ~40 pending; error rate dropping, p50/p95 recovering. Still watching for residual 5xx from cold-start KV misses.
Priya (ops lead): handoff: I need to step out at 1781122650 — handing oncall to Alex for incident stabilization and to drive RCA. Alex, please confirm you'll own postmortem and customer follow-ups.
Alex (SRE): I will own the postmortem and coordinate follow-up. Plan: RCA to include autoscaler policy gap, feature-flag regression, provider quota interplay, and recommendations: 1) make fallback unconditional, 2) reserve critical on-demand capacity, 3) add provider quota monitor + preemptive reservations, 4) add faster cold-start cache warmup path.
Riley (prod): agreed. I'll prepare customer impact matrix for the postmortem.
Alex (SRE): final check — any remaining throttles or queues? If no, we'll declare mitigation complete and set priority P1 -> P2 after 30m stable.
Devon (autoscale): no further throttle events recorded in last 3m. Autoscaler metrics steady.
SLO Bot: incident state: MITIGATED at 1781122699. Please file RCA and tag stakeholders.
Priya (ops lead): thanks team. Leave incident channel open for 1h for follow ups. :raised_hands:
